waltz.rf-closed-change.tip: Changes from natural to reverse figures. Keep the closing foot soft and the body travelling over the side step.

waltz.lf-closed-change.tip: Changes from reverse to natural figures.

man.rf: Continue to rise on 3, lower e/o 3
Continue to rise on 6, lower e/o 6

lady.rf: Continue to rise on 3, lower e/o 3
Continue to rise on 6, lower e/o 6

waltz.natural-turn.tip: ⅜ on each half. Man's step 5 is a small step with the toe pointing DC while the body is still turning.

man.rf: Continue to rise on 3, lower e/o 3
Continue to rise on 6, lower e/o 6

lady.rf: Continue to rise on 3, lower e/o 3
Continue to rise on 6, lower e/o 6

waltz.reverse-turn.tip: Mirror image of the Natural Turn, turning ¾ to the left overall.

man.p: RF diagonally fwd (side and slightly fwd)
LF crosses behind RF in PP

lady.p: LF diagonally back (side and slightly back)
RF crosses behind LF in PP

waltz.whisk.tip: Man has no turn; the Lady turns ¼ to the right into Promenade Position.

man.p: RF fwd and across in PP and CBMP
LF to side and slightly fwd
LF to side and slightly fwd

lady.p: LF fwd and across in PP and CBMP
RF to side and slightly back

waltz.chasse-from-pp.tip: Man ends with RF ready to step outside partner. Lady turns ¼ to the left to close back to her partner.

man.rf: Continue to rise on 3, lower e/o 3

man.p: LF to side and slightly back
man.rf: Continue to rise on 6, lower e/o 6

lady.rf: Continue to rise on 3, lower e/o 3

lady.p: LF back and slightly to side
RF brushes to LF, then diagonally fwd
lady.rf: Continue to rise on 6, lower e/o 6

waltz.natural-spin-turn.tip: Often used to turn a corner. Keep the pivot on step 4 compact with the thighs close.

man.p: LF fwd, preparing to step outside partner
RF fwd in CBMP, outside partner

foxtrot.feather-step.tip: Step 3 is taken in CBMP with the Man outside partner.

foxtrot.three-step.tip: Man steps back in line with his partner after a Feather.

foxtrot.reverse-turn.timing: S Q Q S Q Q

man.p: RF fwd in CBMP, outside partner

lady.p: RF to side and slightly fwd

foxtrot.reverse-turn.tip: Steps 4–6 are the Feather Finish. Lady's heel turn on step 2.

man.p: LF to side and slightly back

lady.p: RF to side and slightly fwd

quickstep.quarter-turn-to-right.tip: Usually danced with the Progressive Chassé as the Quarter Turns along the room.

man.p: LF to side and slightly fwd

lady.p: RF to side and slightly back

quickstep.progressive-chasse.tip: Man ends facing DW with LF, ready to step RF outside partner.

man.p: RF fwd in CBMP, outside partner

lady.p: LF crosses in front of RF

quickstep.forward-lock.tip: Keep the locked foot tight behind and the hips square to DW.

man.tt: Slight curve to L may be used

tango.walk.tip: Tango walks are placed slightly across, with the LF walk taken in slight CBMP.

man.tt: Body turn ¼ to R… body only

man.p: LF to side and slightly back in PP

lady.p: RF to side and slightly back in PP

tango.progressive-link.tip: A sharp head and body action takes the couple into PP; the Lady turns ¼ to the right.

man.p: RF fwd and across in PP and CBMP
LF to side and slightly fwd
RF closes slightly back of LF

lady.p: LF fwd and across in PP and CBMP
RF to side and slightly back
LF closes slightly fwd of RF

tango.closed-promenade.tip: Man's step 4 closes slightly back; Lady closes slightly forward.

viennese.natural-turn.tip: Less rise than Waltz; the turn is continuous at speed.

man.p: LF crosses in front of RF

lady.p: LF crosses in front of RF

viennese.reverse-turn.tip: The crossing step is characteristic of the Viennese Reverse Turn.

chacha.closed-basic.tip: Up to ¼ turn to L may be made over the basic. Forward and back steps are checked with the hips settling into the replace.

man.p: RF fwd in Left Side Position (check)
LF fwd in Right Side Position (check)

lady.p: LF fwd in Right Side Position (check)
RF fwd in Left Side Position (check)

chacha.new-york.tip: Step through with the foot further from your partner, checking forward; the free arm extends to the side.

man.p: RF fwd across in front of LF, toe turned out

man.tt: ¼ to L (1 full turn over 1–3)

lady.p: LF fwd across in front of RF, toe turned out

lady.tt: ¼ to R (1 full turn over 1–3)

chacha.spot-turn.tip: Shown as the Man's Spot Turn to Left and the Lady's to Right, danced together without hold.

man.tt: Up to ¼ to L over 1–6 (optional)

lady.tt: Up to ¼ to L over 1–6 (optional)

rumba.closed-basic.tip: Step on 2; the hip settles through 4-1. Keep steps compact.

rumba.cucarachas.tip: Pressure into the floor on the side step, then replace.

man.tt: No turn (or up to ¼ to R)

man.p: LF closes to RF, part weight
Replace weight to RF in place
RF closes to LF, part weight
Replace weight to LF in place

lady.tt: No turn (or up to ¼ to R)

lady.p: RF closes to LF, part weight
Replace weight to LF in place
LF closes to RF, part weight
Replace weight to RF in place

samba.natural-basic-movement.tip: Danced with the Samba bounce: a slight knee flex on each beat.

man.p: LF crosses behind RF, toe turned out
RF crosses behind LF, toe turned out

lady.p: RF crosses behind LF, toe turned out
LF crosses behind RF, toe turned out

samba.whisks-to-right-and-left.tip: The crossing foot is placed behind on the ball with the toe turned out.

man.tt: Up to ⅛ to L may be made

lady.tt: Up to ⅛ to R may be made

pre: Change of Places Left to Right
fol: Change of Places Right to Left
jive.fallaway-rock.tip: Rock back on 1 with a compact step; chassés are danced with a lilting, springy action.

fol: Change of Places Right to Left
jive.basic-in-place.tip: Chassés in place, knees soft, feet never leaving the floor far.

paso.sur-place.tip: Marching on the spot on the balls of the feet, with a strong, lifted poise.

paso.chasses-to-right-and-left.tip: Shown as Chassés to Right for the Man (to Left for the Lady). Elevated, compact chassés.
